beats.label: S1 · A vampire falls in love
beats.text: The scholarly vampire Dracula marries the human doctor Lisa. Twenty years later, while he is away, the church burns her at the stake as a witch.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Lisa's death is the sole cause of everything that follows across four seasons.

beats.label: S1 · A year to grieve
beats.text: Dracula gives Wallachia a year to make its peace, then unleashes an army of demonic Night Creatures. His son Adrian begs him to spare humanity and is attacked for it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the war Trevor and Sypha are fighting and the father-son rift Alucard carries into the finale.

beats.label: S1 · The last Belmont
beats.text: Trevor Belmont, exiled drunken heir to the vampire-hunting family, arrives in besieged Gresit and defends the nomadic Speakers from a bishop scapegoating them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the protagonist and re-anchors the Belmont name that carries the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · The magician underground
beats.text: Beneath the city Trevor rescues the Speaker Sypha, a powerful magician, from a cyclops. Above ground he exposes the church's crimes as the true cause of Dracula's war.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Sypha and cements the moral framing: the church, not humanity, provoked the genocide.

beats.label: S1 · Waking the sleeper
beats.text: During the battle above, Trevor and Sypha fall into deeper catacombs and wake the prophesied sleeping soldier - Adrian, healing from his fight with his father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Alucard and reveals he has already fought Dracula once, priming the trio's plan.

beats.label: S1 · The trio forms
beats.text: Now calling himself Alucard, he reveals the prophecy foretold this exact meeting. The three commit to hunting down Dracula and ending the war together.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single pact that drives every action of season two.

cliffhanger.text: The trio have just met and united. Dracula's Night Creature army is still slaughtering Wallachia, and his castle can appear anywhere at nightfall.
questions: How do you kill the most powerful vampire in the world?
Can Alucard truly bring himself to end his own father?
How do you strike a castle that will not stay in one place?

characters.name: Trevor Belmont
characters.line: Exiled last son of the Belmont vampire-hunting line; a drunk who has just committed to killing Dracula.

characters.name: Sypha Belnades
characters.line: Young Speaker magician with elemental powers; Trevor's new ally after Gresit.

characters.name: Alucard (Adrian Tepes)
characters.line: Dhampir son of Dracula, wounded from a prior fight with his father and now allied against him.

characters.name: Vlad Dracula Tepes
characters.line: Grief-mad vampire lord waging genocide across Wallachia after his human wife's execution.

characters.name: Lisa
characters.line: Dracula's beloved wife, a doctor burned as a witch; her death started the war.

beats.label: S2 · Dracula's war council
beats.text: Dracula assembles vampire lords from across the world and puts the human forgemasters Hector and Isaac in charge, trusting their hatred of humanity over vampire loyalty.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Hector and Isaac, the two humans whose separate arcs drive seasons three and four.

beats.label: S2 · Carmilla arrives
beats.text: The Styrian vampire mistress Carmilla joins the council and quietly begins turning the generals against Dracula, whose grief has left him uninterested in strategy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the antagonist of the next two seasons and the wedge that dooms Dracula from within.

beats.label: S2 · The Belmont hold
beats.text: The trio reach the ruined Belmont estate and open its buried library. Sypha searches for a way to trap the moving castle while Trevor arms himself with the Morning Star.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The library and the Morning Star become recurring assets; the locking spell is the key to killing Dracula.

beats.label: S2 · The council fractures
beats.text: Isaac kills the vampire Godbrand for treason, staying loyal to Dracula. Carmilla turns Hector, convincing him she can save more humans than Dracula would.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Splits the two forgemasters onto their opposing paths - Isaac loyal, Hector deceived - which defines everything after.

beats.label: S2 · Ambush at Brăila
beats.text: Dracula moves the castle to Brăila; Carmilla's army ambushes and destroys most of his forces at the river. Sypha's spell teleports the castle above the Belmont library.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The castle is now permanently parked over the Belmont hold - it stays there for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S2 · Killing the father
beats.text: The trio storm the castle. Fighting Alucard through his childhood home, Dracula realises he is trying to kill his son, breaks down, and lets Alucard drive the stake in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The central act of the series and the source of Alucard's grief that defines his season three arc.

beats.label: S2 · Everyone scatters
beats.text: Carmilla flees to Styria with Hector as her enslaved forgemaster. Isaac, teleported to safety by Dracula, plots revenge alone. Alucard remains in the empty castle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the exact starting geometry of season three - three separate storylines set here.

cliffhanger.text: Dracula is dead. Carmilla has fled to Styria with Hector enslaved to build her army; Isaac lives, planning revenge; Alucard has inherited an empty castle and unbearable grief.
questions: What will Carmilla do with the power vacuum Dracula left behind?
Will Isaac's revenge fall on Hector first, or Alucard?
Can Alucard bear guarding his father's castle alone?

characters.name: Trevor Belmont
characters.line: Belmont hunter; killed Dracula alongside Sypha and Alucard, now romantically bonded with Sypha and travelling with her.

characters.name: Sypha Belnades
characters.line: Magician and Trevor's partner; her locking spell brought Dracula's castle down.

characters.name: Alucard
characters.line: Dhampir who drove the stake into his own father's heart, now alone as the keeper of Dracula's castle.

characters.name: Carmilla
characters.line: Styrian vampire who engineered Dracula's downfall to seize the power vacuum; fled home with Hector as her slave.

characters.name: Hector
characters.line: Human forgemaster who created Dracula's Night Creatures; betrayed by Carmilla and now her enslaved property.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.line: Human forgemaster loyal to Dracula, who saved him by teleporting him to a desert; now alive and plotting revenge on Hector.

beats.label: S3 · A month after
beats.text: A month after Dracula's death the survivors scatter. Trevor and Sypha hunt cultists across the land; Alucard tries to bear his father's castle alone; Isaac plans his revenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the four parallel storylines the entire season braids.

beats.label: S3 · Council of Sisters
beats.text: In Styria, Carmilla and her three sister vampires plan to build an empire farmed on human blood. Lenore, the smallest sister, volunteers to break the imprisoned Hector.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Council and Lenore, the season's most consequential new character.

beats.label: S3 · Lindenfeld and Saint Germain
beats.text: In Lindenfeld, Trevor and Sypha meet Saint Germain, a magician chasing his lost love through an interdimensional Infinite Corridor being opened inside the local priory.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Germain and the Corridor - both central to the finale's resurrection plot.

beats.label: S3 · Sumi and Taka
beats.text: Two Japanese vampire hunters, Sumi and Taka, arrive at Dracula's castle and ask Alucard to train them. Lonely, he takes them in as students.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the betrayal that finishes off Alucard emotionally.

beats.label: S3 · Isaac's march
beats.text: Isaac crosses the sea, slaughters those who bar his path, and takes over a magician's built-slave city, gaining a mirror that can transport his army to Carmilla's castle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Isaac's army within instant reach of Styria - the geographic setup for the season four battle.

beats.label: S3 · Lindenfeld unravels
beats.text: Sala's priory triggers a portal to hell, briefly revealing Dracula and Lisa; Trevor destroys the Visitor demon and Germain escapes into the Corridor to search for his love.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First glimpse of Dracula and Lisa's souls, and Germain vanishes with a mission that returns him next season.

beats.label: S3 · Two betrayals
beats.text: Lenore tricks Hector into a slave ring binding his creatures to the sisters. At Dracula's castle Sumi and Taka betray Alucard; he kills them and mounts their bodies outside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hector is now magically bound to the Council; Alucard has crossed into darkness. Both states carry directly into season four.

cliffhanger.text: Hector is magically enslaved to the Council of Sisters. Isaac has an army and a mirror pointing straight at Styria. Germain wanders the Infinite Corridor; Alucard is broken and dangerous.
questions: What will Isaac do when he steps through that mirror into Carmilla's castle?
Will Hector remain a slave, or is Lenore herself becoming attached to him?
Can anyone reach Alucard before grief turns him into what he hunts?

characters.name: Trevor Belmont
characters.line: Belmont hunter; scarred by discovering the Judge of Lindenfeld's secret child-killings under his own protection.

characters.name: Sypha Belnades
characters.line: Trevor's partner, equally shaken by Lindenfeld; still hunting cultists trying to resurrect Dracula.

characters.name: Alucard
characters.line: Dhampir betrayed by his students Sumi and Taka; killed them and impaled their bodies as warnings, deeply broken.

characters.name: Hector
characters.line: Forgemaster; seduced by Lenore and magically enslaved to the Council through a ring on his finger.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.line: Forgemaster; has built his own Night Creature army and now possesses a mirror that opens straight into Styria.

characters.name: Carmilla
characters.line: Vampire lord of Styria; leads the Council of Sisters in a plan to farm humanity for blood across a continent.

characters.name: Lenore
characters.line: Diplomat sister of the Council; broke Hector with kindness and a slave ring, and may be genuinely attached to him.

characters.name: Saint Germain
characters.line: Magician who vanished into the Infinite Corridor to find his lost love, at any cost.

beats.label: S4 · Six weeks later
beats.text: Six weeks after Lindenfeld, Trevor and Sypha reach ruined Târgoviște; the vampires Varney and Ratko lurk nearby. Trevor picks up a magical dagger in the rubble.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The dagger and the artifacts he keeps collecting are what will kill Death in the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Danesti summons
beats.text: Alucard is called to defend the village of Danesti and meets Saint Germain again - who is secretly the architect of the attacks, luring refugees into Dracula's castle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals Germain's turn and the plot's design: use the castle and its deaths to open the Corridor.

beats.label: S4 · Hector's double game
beats.text: In Styria, Hector and Lenore have become genuine lovers. Secretly, he plants magic stones through Carmilla's castle walls and conspires with Germain and Varney.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Hector is now playing every side; the stones are the trap that ends Carmilla.

beats.label: S4 · Battle of Styria
beats.text: Isaac's Night Creatures storm Carmilla's castle. Hector's stones seal Carmilla in her throne room; refusing capture, she kills herself. Isaac spares Hector and claims Styria.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Carmilla from the board, installs Isaac as a ruler, and pays off both forgemasters' arcs.

beats.label: S4 · Two fronts converge
beats.text: In Târgoviște, Trevor kills Ratko with a cross-blade from the Underground Court. At Dracula's castle Dragan's army arrives bearing a Rebis stitched from many corpses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts every artifact and every player in position for the ritual that closes the series.

beats.label: S4 · Death revealed
beats.text: Varney reveals as the elemental Death and forces Germain to summon Dracula and Lisa into the Rebis. The trio destroys it; Trevor slays Death and vanishes in the blast.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The true antagonist of the series and his defeat, at the apparent cost of Trevor's life.

beats.label: S4 · Two weeks after
beats.text: Trevor returns wounded through the Corridor to a pregnant Sypha. Lenore walks into the sun. Dracula and Lisa live quietly as commoners, letting their son have his own life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every surviving character's final resting position - what the world of Castlevania looks like from now on.

cliffhanger.text: The war is over. Trevor is back and Sypha is pregnant; Alucard has turned his father's castle into a refuge with Greta; and Dracula and Lisa are quietly alive again, hidden from everyone who knew them.
questions: Will Trevor and Sypha's child ever know a world without Night Creatures?
Can Isaac hold Styria as a human king of monsters?
What happens the day the world learns Dracula walks again?

characters.name: Trevor Belmont
characters.line: Belmont hunter; presumed dead after killing the elemental Death, returned wounded through the Corridor to Sypha.

characters.name: Sypha Belnades
characters.line: Magician and Trevor's partner; pregnant with his child, settled at Dracula's castle.

characters.name: Alucard
characters.line: Dhampir; presides over Dracula's castle as a refugee settlement with Greta at his side.

characters.name: Vlad Dracula Tepes
characters.line: Resurrected by the failed ritual and quietly alive with Lisa, hiding as a commoner.

characters.name: Lisa
characters.line: Also resurrected; content to live in hiding with Dracula and let their son believe them gone.

characters.name: Hector
characters.line: Forgemaster; free of the slave ring, chose to stay in Styria with Lenore.

characters.name: Isaac
characters.line: Forgemaster; claimed Styria as his own kingdom after killing its ruler.

characters.name: Lenore
characters.line: Vampire diplomat; unable to face defeat and Isaac's presence, walked into the sun.

characters.name: Saint Germain
characters.line: Magician manipulated by Death into raising Dracula; died distracting Death long enough for Trevor to strike.

characters.name: Greta
characters.line: Leader of Danesti village; Alucard's partner in the castle settlement.
